scene clearnightsky
What does it take to move forward?
It’s a simple question. And it’s been answered several times throughout the course of this story, but never with a constant.
You see, there are certain variables that come into play when we’re asked broad, somewhat philosophical questions like that.
And, as fun as it is to dance around them with vague non-answers, there’s gotta be something.
Right?
Like, there has to be one thing that everyone can do to leave the past behind and begin the next chapter in their life.
And no. This is not the part where I don my favorite hypocrite costume and spoon-feed you the concept of waiting as a tongue-in-cheek non-answer to a tangent about my distaste for non-answers.
It’s the part where I scratch the space beneath my chin that you used to scratch when your hands still worked the way they were meant to and think-
So I think-
But I think I’m confused.
It’s dark in here right now. And that’s fine. I’m used to the dark and I’m used to waiting. And I know that all of this is sure to blow over if I can just keep my head held high.
And all those worries and vague thoughts about what it takes to move forward will one day click or fall into place or do whatever it is they’re supposed to do.
Like hands that shake too much to hold-
Like plants that grow without being watered-
Like the angel in the back of my head reminding me to be yours-
The clocks will tick onward.
Even when they lack their arms.
That’s it.
That’s all I have to say.
I’m not sure why you’re still-
scene yuminorikocon1
Oh, fuck. Yumi Yamaguchi s- ahem!
Yumi Yamaguchi swings open the door to a convenience store that she has avoided most nights before on account of one of her classmates working here.
And she was feeling a bit hesitant as that classmate, Noriko Nakayama, had been causing a lot of problems for her lately.
You see, for reasons Yumi Yamaguchi did not understand, Noriko Nakayama was attempting to become her friend! Even going as far as telling her to come apply for a job at the store she’d been avoiding!
But, desperate for cash and not willing to sell her body to the many people out there who would be willing to pay for it, Yumi had run out of options and somehow found herself here.
: Uhh...yo.

She called out, unsure of whether or not this was going to be some sort of set-up. Because, while Noriko didn’t seem like the type to do such a thing, Yumi was quite averse to the whole idea of “trust.”
: Yumi! Great timing!
Like a hawk, Noriko swoops down and barrages the Yakuza princess with talons of congeniality!
scene yuminorikocon2
Then the shot changes and I go take a nap. Bye!
: Hey! I was starting to think you weren’t going to show up.
: I just...happened to be in the area and shit.
scene yuminorikocon3

: Yeah. You live around here, don’t you? I remember you saying something about that. Were you applying to other places? Which ones? Because I don’t think there are many others still open out here and-
: You...
scene yuminorikocon4
: You talk a lot, don’t you?
: Me? Oh, yeah. I could talk forever if I had to. Plus, we’ve been dead all night long and I’m just excited to be with another human now.
: So, are you still looking for a job?
: I mean...yeah. But I ain’t really great at interviews and applications and shit, so I was hopin’ we could kinda just skip all that and you could just, like...pay me.
: Cool! You’re hired.
scene yuminorikocon5
: I’m what?
: Hired! You start right now.
: Pay is ¥1,000 per hour and you’ll be taking the morning shifts on weekends once you’re fully trained. But I’ll have you shadowing me for a while so I can show you the ropes.
: Are you, like...the manager here? Ain’t you a little young to be just hirin’ some girl on a whim like this?
scene yuminorikocon6
: I already talked to the boss about it. I’ve been pushing for someone else my age to work here forever now and it’s not like we get many applicants all the way out here.
scene yuminorikocon7
: Granted, it was Kirin I had in mind when I brought up the idea. But I’m starting to realize she might be banking on one of those lives where she just never has to work a single day.
: Plus, she was already fired from Pepper Lunch a while back and might not be the most responsible person to-
: Sorry for interruptin’ in the middle of your...many lines of dialogue. But what makes you so sure I ain’t gonna be just as unreliable as that Kirin girl?
scene yuminorikocon8
: A hunch!
: That’s it?
: Yeah! Cause, like, even if you do suck, you’ll be here at the same time as me and I can just help you out.
: And if worse comes to worst and you get fired, at least we’ll be able to become better friends!
: You know I ain’t gonna be your friend just cause you got me a job, right?
: We’ll see about that!
scene yuminorikocon9
: Noriko...why are you doin’ this shit for me? I ain’t done anythin’ to deserve it. Hell, I ain’t said anything nice to or about you in...probably forever. It doesn’t make sense.
: Why do I need a reason to do something nice for someone?

: You need a job and I want to be friends. And hey, you can even use those facts to rationalize this inside your head if you can’t bring yourself to understand that good people actually just exist sometimes.
scene yuminorikocon10
: Plus, with a shirt like that, you already fit in with the ska music that’s always playing in here!
: Why do I feel like this ain’t the first time somebody’s said shit about ska music to me?
scene yuminorikocon11
: Are you wearing a sarashi?
: Eyes up here, Pinky.
scene yuminorikocon12
: Are you wearing a sarashi?
: Listen. If we’re gonna be friends or co-workers or whatever the fuck we’re gonna be, you can’t be askin’ me personal shit like that.
: That’s a little counterintuitive to what friends are supposed to be, but noted.
scene yuminorikocon13
: Boobs aside, though! Why don’t I give you a little tour of our new little love-nest while we’re still dead?
: Can we, like...not call it that?
scene black
: Absolutely! We’re all about creating a comfortable, healthy environment here! You don’t like the way you’re being spoken to? Speak up! You want to wear a sarashi? Wear a sarashi!
: Can you please leave what I do with my god damn tits out of this?! That ain’t got shit to do with work!
scene yuminorikocon14
: True. But you haven’t clocked in yet, so you’re not technically working right now.
: Well...then how the fuck do I-
: Just kidding. You don’t have to clock in yet. I’ll keep track of your time manually. But you’re right. We should wait until we’re clocked out to talk about boobs and the like.
: Or just...never?
: We’ll see! But yeah, orientation...commence!
scene yuminorikocon15
: These aisles are where we keep all the dry goods. They’re normally restocked at night, so you won’t have to worry about them most mornings unless you start running low on something.
: I’ll show you how we do that the next time you work, though, since I already took care of it before you came in tonight.
scene yuminorikocon16
: Is it more complicated than just, like...taking shit out of a box and puttin’ it in the right place?
: A little. We’ve gotta scan everything in when we put it on the shelves and make sure we rotate the products too.
: Make the labels face the right direction. Got it.
: No, like...rotating when it comes to food and stuff means placing the new product behind the old product so that the same things don’t stay on the shelves forever and expire before they’re bought.
: There’s a little acronym called FIFO — first in, first out — that should help you remember to do that.
: You won’t get charged or anything for stuff that does expire, but it’s better for business and the environment if we can avoid wasting stuff.
: Oh, and any of the dry food that does pass expiration can be pulled from the shelves and put in the box with my name on it in the back.
scene yuminorikocon17
: We’re allowed to take shit home once it’s expired?!
: Yes! That’s not what that box is for, though. I take all the expired stuff to a homeless shelter down the road on my way home after work. You can take whatever, though.
: And you ain’t gonna look down on me for keepin’ it to myself instead of feeding a bunch of fuckin’ homeless people?
: I mean...how much do you need?
: Bitch, I’ve got a family to feed.
scene yuminorikocon18
: I might be able to put some in your stupid fuckin’ homeless box, though. We’ll see.
: Great!
scene black
: Now! Follow me to our next destination!
: Huh? Oh. Shit. Yeah. On it.
scene yuminorikocon19
: This is the cafe. We can help ourselves to free coffee all night so long as we brew it. Which we should be doing anyway in case customers want it.
: Nobody really buys anything from here during the graveyard shift, but I hear it can get pretty busy during the morning, so I’ll show you how to handle that in a few minutes.
: Can we take some of those pastries and shit too?
: We’re supposed to pay for them. But yes. As long as you don’t take like, a suspicious amount of them, you should be fine.
: How many is suspicious?
: I don’t know, Yumi. Use your judgement. Take whatever amount of scones you normally consume per sitting and just...halve it or something.
: The fuck is a scone? I just want a muffin.
scene black
: Then you shall have a muffin! And I will now show you where you will be able to eat that muffin!
: Is there really a fuckin’ designated muffin zone at this weird ass convenience store?
scene yuminorikocon20
: There is! But we normally just call it the dining area instead and no one but me will understand what you mean if you call it the muffin zone.
scene yuminorikocon21
: I don’t mind, though. We’re going to need a bunch more fun, little inside-jokes like that if we’re going to be friends. Which we are.
: You’re really goin’ hard on this whole fuckin’ friend thing, huh? The slutty one not cuttin’ it for you?
: Kirin’s actually a great friend. Her open sexuality is more of a mask to hide her insecurities.
scene yuminorikocon22
: You mean like you and the way you dress?
: Hm? What’s wrong with the way I dress?
scene yuminorikocon23
: I mean...ain’t you wearin’ all that flashy shit to sorta compensate for somethin’? Like...fuck if I know. What’s some shit normal girls get all self-conscious about?
: Idunno. Boobs?
scene yuminorikocon24
: Oh that’s what the sarashi is for! You’re self-conscious about how huge-
: Mind tellin’ me about company policy when it comes to beatin’ the shit out of other employees?
: Don’t do it.
: You’re damn lucky I’m broke as shit, Pinky.
scene yuminorikocon25
: Call me Noriko again. I like hearing you say my name.
: Uhh...why?
: Idunno.
scene yuminorikocon26
: Ah! What if it’s love?!
: Then I need to find a new fuckin’ job.
scene yuminorikocon27
: No worries, Yumi! Thankfully for you, my heart’s been set on the same man ever since-
: Yeah, yeah, yeah. Heard it a trillion times before from every other fuckin’ girl who’s ever tried talkin’ to me.
: Say, mind if we leave the predator shit outta discussions at work? That’d be nice.
: Got it!
scene yuminorikocon28
: That does remind me that I need to call my sister, though. So why don’t I give you a task so simple that even a kid could do it while I go and do that?
: You’re gonna...leave me alone even though I’m only like ten minutes into having this job?
: Just for a second. And, like I said, it’ll be easy. You can just wipe down a few tables and I’ll be back before you even know it.
: And if anyone shows up, just tell them I’ll be back in a second to ring them up. Under no circumstances try to do that yourself. Got it?
: Now, I ain’t ever paid attention in school before, but I’ve read enough manga and shit to know foreshadowing when I hear it.
: Then just...don’t give in to your manga-related knowledge?
scene black
: Here. I’ll show you where the cleaning stuff is.
scene yuminorikocon29
: Yeah...all right. I can handle this shit for ¥1,000 an hour. And a...non-suspicious amount of muffins. Whatever the fuck that means.
scene yuminorikocon30
: Could deal without the fuckin’ lunatic co-worker, though. Can’t tell if she actually wants to be my friend or if she’s just tryin’ to get in my fuckin’ pants.
scene yuminorikocon29
: Probably got it from her fuckin’ role model. Wouldn’t be surprised if that’s who she was callin’ right now instead of her sister.
: Whatever, though. Ain’t my problem. Just gonna...do my job and get the fuck out of here...
: For Eleven Sports, I’ve been Takuya Tanaka. Thanks as always for watching, and stay tuned until next time.
: Up next is Untitled Children’s Show.
scene yuminorikocon31
: Huh?
scene yuminorikocon32
: Okay, Kentaro-kun! If you answer this next question correctly, you’ll be named the kid of the month! Are you ready?
: Good!
: We learned today with the help of Mr. Jefferson and his best friend David the Dinosaur that sometimes, too much of a good thing can actually be bad!
: But we also learned that it’s just as easy for bad things to feel good! Which makes growing up veeeeery tricky since “temptation” is hard to avoid.

: And it’s like that for adults as well! Which is why it’s important to understand that eeeeeveryone has demons they’re dealing with. And that we should be good to one another since we don’t know them!
: Now, Kentaro-kun! Can you figure out which of today’s cast members has been the demon all along?
: Leo. The leprechaun.
: Umm...
: It’s Leo. Say Leo.
: Now remember, Kentaro-kun! When Mr. Jefferson and David went under the bridge, who was it that lured them there with the promise of gold?
: Uuuuuummmmmm.......
: Leo! It’s Leo the Leprechaun!
: Yaaaaay! You did it, Kentaro-kun! This means you’re the new kid of the month!
: Took him long enough.
: Everybody, please give Kentaro-kun a round of applause for his great work today!
: And, if you’re one of our loyal viewers at home, please call in after the show is over and tell us how you felt about today’s episode. But make sure to get your parents’ permission first!
: Breaking the rules is bad. And remember, even if something bad feels good, you have to avoid “temptation” or you’ll become a demon too!
: But don’t worry! If you’re confused about something, you can always ask an adult. They’ve been around waaaaaay longer, and they’ll know what’s best for you!
: And you’ll always have us as well! We love you!
: Be good to your friends, be good to your parents, and be good to yourself!
: Thanks as always for watching Untitled Children’s Show!
scene yuminorikocon33
: Mom! Can I use your phone?
: Mom? Are you awake?
scene yuminorikocon32
: I bet Kentaro’s mom is awake right now.
scene yuminorikocon34

: Now, Kentaro-kun! Can you figure out which of today’s cast members has been the demon all along?
: Leo.

: Ummm...

: Uuuuuummmmmm.......
scene yuminorikocon35
: It’s the fucking leprechaun! How the hell are you this stupid?!
: Ooh! Untitled Children’s Show! I used to watch this with Sensei all the time!
scene yuminorikocon36
: LEO! SAY “LEO” YOU FUCKING IDIOT!
: YOU THINK YOU CAN BE KID OF THE MONTH LIKE THAT?! FUCK YOU, KENTARO-KUN! FUCK YOU! YOU FUCKING IDIOT! IT’S LEO!
: ...Yumi?
scene yuminorikocon37
: Huh?
: Is...Is everything okay?
: You spilled the sanitizer all over the- wait, are you shaking? What’s-
: I have to go.
scene black
: Leo! It’s Leo the Leprechaun!
scene yuminorikocon38
: Where are you going?
: Let go of me.
: Where are you going?
: Home. I ain’t ready to work today.
: Yumi-
: Just fuckin’ fire me if that’s a problem, okay? I’m goin’ home. I ain’t fuckin’...capable, I...
: I just can’t do this right now.
: You won’t come back if I let go of you.
scene yuminorikocon39
: So what?! You’ll have much bigger problems if you don’t fuckin’ do that right now, dipshit!
: Bigger problems? Are you gonna hit me?
: So what if I am?!
: You’ve been annoying the shit out of me all night! You’re lucky I haven’t fucking done it already!
: Yumi-
: Stop fucking saying my name! We’re not friends! We ain’t gonna be friends!
: Yumi, I’ll change the channel.
scene yuminorikocon40
: What? A stupid TV show ain’t the fuckin’ problem! It’s you! You’re the one who’s pissin’ me off!
: Yumi. It’s okay.
: I didn’t see anything. And it’s time for you to go on break. Your shift isn’t over yet.
scene yuminorikocon41
: Why are you-
: Let’s just...
: Let’s shut up for a few minutes.
scene black
Yumi and Noriko are now friends(?)!
